"""独立复算算法逐项变异，确保小域穷举能检出错误。"""
import importlib.util,inspect,json
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('o','/tmp/gmyhf_batch2_oracles.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
changes=[('cards','count+1','count','漏计被使用的牌'),('stack_count','//(n+1)','//(n+2)','卡特兰数分母错误'),('signed_sum','-2*','+2*','幂次项符号错误'),('extract','k-1-j//2','k-2-j//2','交替抽取右端偏一'),('coins','dist[x]+1','dist[x]+2','BFS边权错误'),('exams','debt-=1','debt-=2','一天复习两天内容'),('blocks','j not in assignment or augment(assignment[j],seen)','True','积木可重复使用'),('rain','join(i,outside,h)','None','边界不与外界连通'),('graph','cycle=True','cycle=False','忽略成环边'),('less_equal','x<=mid','x<mid','把小于等于误为严格小于')]
rows=[]
for name,old,new,reason in changes:
 original=getattr(m,name);src=inspect.getsource(original);assert old in src;exec(compile(src.replace(old,new),'<mutation>','exec'),m.__dict__)
 try:m.selfcheck()
 except (AssertionError,ValueError,IndexError):killed=True
 else:killed=False
 setattr(m,name,original);assert killed,name;rows.append({'function':name,'defect':reason,'replace_before':old,'replace_after':new,'killed':True})
 print(name,'变异检出',flush=True)
Path('/tmp/gmyhf-batch2-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

mutations.replace_before: j not in assignment or augment(assignment[j],seen)

mutations.defect: 把小于等于误为严格小于
